models_evaluated: Real-time machine learning clinical deterioration prediction algorithm

links.outcome: Escalation rate, orders, and mortality with ML alerts versus standard care
links.effect: Escalation 12.3 vs 11.3 per 1000 bed days (IPTW IRR 1.43, 95% CI 1.16-1.78); combined mortality 7% vs 9.3% (IPTW RR 0.76, 95% CI 0.58-0.99)
links.quote: Real-time machine learning alerts do not reduce the rate of escalation but may reduce mortality.

unlisted_practices: Sending ML deterioration alerts directly to the rapid response team versus the primary team
